risks.title: Economic Slowdown
risks.score_rationale: An economic slowdown could reduce demand for IBM's products and services, directly impacting the company's revenues and profits

risks.title: Innovation Failure
risks.score_rationale: IBM must continue leading innovation in hybrid cloud, AI, and disruptive technologies to maintain its market share and profit margins

risks.title: Reputational Damage
risks.score_rationale: IBM owns one of the strongest global brands. Reputational damage could impact its ability to attract and retain customers and talent

risks.title: Investment Risks
risks.score_rationale: IBM's investments in new technologies carry risks, but also opportunities for growth

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity risks increase with the growing use of AI and cloud technology in IBM's operations

risks.title: Dependence on Skilled Workforce
risks.score_rationale: IBM's ability to attract and retain skilled talent in hybrid cloud and AI is critical to maintaining its competitive advantage

risks.title: Supplier Risks
risks.score_rationale: IBM relies on suppliers for key components, particularly in semiconductors and cloud infrastructure

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes related to AI, data protection, and cloud activities could impact IBM's operations
